analysis_contract.template_control: subtract each template's across-month mean before averaging
analysis_contract.block_selection: within-seed month contrast weighted by absolute between-month energy and BatchTopK selection frequency
analysis_contract.bsc_layer_alignment: per-site encoder contributions projected through one common PCA basis per seed; no independent layer rotation
analysis_contract.plot_scaling: each panel centered and RMS-normalized for shape comparison
analysis_contract.cycle_test: 20,000 fixed-seed label permutations of closed calendar path length
analysis_contract.shape_read: exploratory: ring requires neighbor recall >=0.625, permutation p<=0.05, closure<=1.75, and radial CV<=0.35
